overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that checking for an existing vote once at the start of the function is sufficient to prevent race conditions when two concurrent requests toggle the same vote.

evidence.quote: Then I need toggleVoteAction, which checks for an existing vote by user+feedback and either deletes (un-vote) or creates it
await prisma.vote.create({ data: { feedbackId, userId: user.id } });

why_it_breaks: When a user double-clicks the upvote button, two concurrent requests both execute the findUnique check at line 99-101 before either completes. Both see no existing vote, both enter the else branch at line 105-106, and both attempt to create a vote record. The second create operation violates the unique constraint on (feedbackId, userId), causing the PrismaClientKnownRequestError.
